label: Q44 essential-source supply from actual identity ancestry and reception
meaning: Each participant is actual with distinct represented esse. Its existing identity-bearing ancestor is therefore distinct from it and actual. The explicit composition law collapses the nonempty actual esse-cause chain. The four existing reception premises exclude a receiver for that identity bearer and pass from nonreception to primitive OwnBeing. This gives the existing existential source-supply statement. The ancestor may vary by participant; no global uniqueness, selected p, Fourth Way or GOD_4 identification is needed. No premise truth or historical derivation is established.
